title: 23.32. Hīnattika, Kusalattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nahīnaṁ nakusalaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā majjhimo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā cha …pe… avigate cha.
Nahīnaṁ naakusalaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā hīno akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Nahīnaṁ naabyākataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca majjhimo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā cha, adhipatiyā cha …pe… avigate cha.
